trajectory_summary: This is a low-friction, self-initiated lead that books cleanly, but the rep leaves real value on the table: competitive intel (Sunrun pricing, battery count) is captured passively rather than mined, a climate-viability objection is voiced and never addressed, and the rep drifts into a personal EV tangent that burns time without advancing qualification. The appointment gets set with day, time, and bill-collection all in place, so the mechanics succeed even though the conversational discipline is loose.

observed_outcome.quote: I will get you on our schedule for Friday the eighth at 3PM, you said. Right?
observed_outcome.reasoning: A specific day (Friday the 8th) and time (3PM) are confirmed by both parties, and the rep frames it as a specialist visit ('find a time that one of my specialists can stop by and show you our estimate'), indicating an in-person appointment channel.
